```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(haven)
library(gtsummary)
library(flextable)
library(officer)
```

```{r}
data <- read_dta("../Data/diet_variables_updated2.dta")
# Convert all labelled variables to factors
data <- data %>%
  mutate(across(where(haven::is.labelled), haven::as_factor)) %>% 
  mutate(
    Diet_Diversity=case_when(
      Diet_Diversity=="Inadequate Dietary Diversity" ~ "Inadequate",
      Diet_Diversity=="Adequate Dietary Diversity" ~ "Adequate"
    ) %>% factor(levels = c("Adequate","Inadequate")))

vars <- c(
  "age",
  "gender",
  "marital",
  "university_location",
  "year",
  "living_situation",
  "income_source_house",
  "income_house",
  "income_category",
  "working_hours_day",
  "pay_tuition",
  "mental_health_services",
  "socioeconomic_status",
  "family_support_financial",
  "antidepressant",
  "sleeping_hours",
  "physical_activity",
  "smoke",
  "Depression",
  "Anxiety",
  "Stress",
  "Depression_Level",
  "Anxiety_Level",
  "Stress_Level",
  "FGDS",
  "Diet_Diversity",
  "GDR_Score",
  "employment_recode"
)
```



```{r}
# Create the summary table
univariate <- data %>%
  select(vars) %>% 
  tbl_summary(
    by = NULL,
    statistic = list(all_continuous() ~ "{mean} ({sd})", all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"),
    digits = all_continuous() ~ 2,
    missing = "no"
  ) %>%
  bold_labels()

# Convert to flextable for Word
univariate_flex <- as_flex_table(univariate)

# Create Word document and add table
doc <- read_docx() %>%
  body_add_flextable(univariate_flex)

# Save to file
print(doc, target = "univariate_summary2.docx")


```

```{r}

dep_formula <- Depression ~ age + gender + marital + university_location + year + 
               living_situation + income_source_house + income_house + income_category + 
               working_hours_day + pay_tuition + mental_health_services + socioeconomic_status + 
               family_support_financial + antidepressant + sleeping_hours + physical_activity + 
               smoke + FGDS + Diet_Diversity + GDR_Score + employment_recode

anx_formula <- Anxiety ~ age + gender + marital + university_location + year + 
               living_situation + income_source_house + income_house + income_category + 
               working_hours_day + pay_tuition + mental_health_services + socioeconomic_status + 
               family_support_financial + antidepressant + sleeping_hours + physical_activity + 
               smoke + FGDS + Diet_Diversity + GDR_Score + employment_recode

str_formula <- Stress ~ age + gender + marital + university_location + year + 
               living_situation + income_source_house + income_house + income_category + 
               working_hours_day + pay_tuition + mental_health_services + socioeconomic_status + 
               family_support_financial + antidepressant + sleeping_hours + physical_activity + 
               smoke + FGDS + Diet_Diversity + GDR_Score + employment_recode
```


```{r}
dep_mod <- lm(dep_formula, data = data)
anx_mod <- lm(anx_formula, data = data)
str_mod <- lm(str_formula, data = data)
```



```{r}
summary(dep_mod)
summary(anx_mod)
summary(str_mod)
```







```{r}
library(gtsummary)

dep_tbl <- tbl_regression(dep_mod, label = list(), intercept = TRUE) %>%
  bold_labels()

anx_tbl <- tbl_regression(anx_mod, label = list(), intercept = TRUE) %>%
  bold_labels()

str_tbl <- tbl_regression(str_mod, label = list(), intercept = TRUE) %>%
  bold_labels()
```


```{r}
multi_model_tbl <- tbl_merge(
  list(dep_tbl, anx_tbl, str_tbl),
  tab_spanner = c("Depression", "Anxiety", "Stress")
)
```


```{r}
library(officer)
library(flextable)

doc <- read_docx() %>%
  body_add_flextable(as_flex_table(multi_model_tbl))

print(doc, target = "mental_health_models.docx")
```




```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# Example data
data <- tribble(
  ~Characteristic, ~Outcome, ~Beta, ~CI_low, ~CI_high, ~p_value,
  "Age", "Depression", 0.28, -0.97, 1.5, 0.7,
  "Age", "Anxiety", -0.03, -1.0, 0.99, 0.9,
  "Age", "Stress", -0.05, -1.2, 1.1, 0.9,
  "Married (ref: Unmarried)", "Depression", 7.1, -0.57, 15, 0.070,
  "Married (ref: Unmarried)", "Anxiety", 8.7, 2.4, 15, 0.007,
  "Married (ref: Unmarried)", "Stress", 4.9, -2.1, 12, 0.2,
  "Lower SES (ref: Upper)", "Depression", 15, 5.9, 23, 0.001,
  "Lower SES (ref: Upper)", "Anxiety", 8.3, 1.1, 16, 0.023,
  "Lower SES (ref: Upper)", "Stress", 11, 2.6, 19, 0.009
  # Add more rows here...
)

```

```{r}
ggplot(data, aes(x = Beta, y = Characteristic, color = Outcome)) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = CI_low, xmax = CI_high), 
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), 
                width = 0.2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Regression Coefficients with 95% CI",
       x = "Beta Estimate",
       y = "",
       color = "Outcome") +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10))

```
```{r}
df <- data
```


```{r}
# Assuming df is your dataset
df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Depression_Level, Anxiety_Level, Stress_Level), 
               names_to = "Outcome", 
               values_to = "Score") %>% 
ggplot(aes(x = Score, fill = Outcome)) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Depression, Anxiety, and Stress Levels",
    x = "Severity Level",
    y = "Count",
    fill = " "
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Depression_Level" = "#1f77b4", 
               "Anxiety_Level" = "#ff7f0e", 
               "Stress_Level" = "#2ca02c"),
    labels = c("Depression_Level" = "Depression",
               "Anxiety_Level" = "Anxiety",
               "Stress_Level" = "Stress")
  )

```


```{r}
df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Depression, Anxiety, Stress), 
               names_to = "Outcome", 
               values_to = "Score") %>% 
ggplot(aes(x = gender)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(y = Score, fill = gender)) +
  facet_grid(. ~ Outcome, scales = "free_y") +  # column layout
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "Mental Health Scores by Gender", 
    x = " ", 
    y = "Score", 
    fill = "Gender"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Male" = "#1f77b4", "Female" = "#e377c2"),
    labels = c("Male" = "Male", "Female" = "Female")
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    strip.placement = "outside"
  )
```

```{r}
df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Depression, Anxiety, Stress), 
               names_to = "Outcome", 
               values_to = "Score") %>% 
  filter(income_category != "None") %>% 
  mutate(
    income_category=case_when(
      income_category=="Less than 5000" ~ "<5000",
      income_category=="5000 to 10000" ~ "5000–10000",
      .default = ">10000"
    ) %>% 
      factor(levels = c( "<5000", "5000–10000", ">10000"))
  ) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = income_category, y = Score, fill = gender)) +
  geom_boxplot(position = position_dodge()) +
  facet_grid(. ~ Outcome, scales = "free") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "Interaction: Gender × Income Category on Mental Health Scores",
    x = "Income Category",
    y = "Score",
    fill = "Gender"
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 1)) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Male" = "#1f77b4", "Female" = "#e377c2")
  ) 



```
